description: Header file defining Vulkan resource management classes and functions for the ATen native Vulkan API, including memory allocation, buffer, image, and fence management.

classes.name: MemoryBarrier
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan memory barrier with source and destination access flags.

classes.name: MemoryAllocation
classes.description: Encapsulates Vulkan memory allocation details, including requirements, create info, and handle.

classes.name: VulkanBuffer
classes.description: Manages Vulkan buffer resources, including creation, binding, and memory management.

classes.name: MemoryMap
classes.description: Provides mapped access to Vulkan buffer memory for reading or writing.

classes.name: BufferMemoryBarrier
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan buffer memory barrier for synchronization.

classes.name: ImageSampler
classes.description: Encapsulates a Vulkan image sampler with properties and handle management.

classes.name: VulkanImage
classes.description: Manages Vulkan image resources, including creation, view, sampler, and memory binding.

classes.name: ImageMemoryBarrier
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan image memory barrier for synchronization.

classes.name: SamplerCache
classes.description: Caches Vulkan image samplers for reuse, with thread-safe access.

classes.name: MemoryAllocator
classes.description: Handles Vulkan memory allocations, resource creation, and statistics.

classes.name: VulkanFence
classes.description: Wraps a Vulkan fence object for synchronization.

classes.name: FencePool
classes.description: Manages a pool of Vulkan fences for reuse.
